subject: Learning Methods
title: Weekly Note Consolidation
description: Learn Weekly Note Consolidation in one minute.

hook.text: Every Sunday she spent 30 minutes merging the week's notes into clean summaries.

buildup.text: Weekly consolidation means combining, reorganizing, and summarizing the week's notes into a coherent review document.

discovery.text: Consolidating forces spaced review and generative processing simultaneously. You retrieve and transform in one session.

twist.text: The consolidated notes become your study guide. You've already done the hard work of synthesis before exam season.

climax.text: Set a weekly 30-minute block to consolidate. Ask: what were the key ideas this week?

punchline.text: Thirty minutes weekly. Your future self gets exam-ready notes.

quiz.question: What dual benefit does weekly note consolidation provide?
options: It reduces paper usage and saves filing space
It combines spaced review with generative processing simultaneously
It satisfies course requirements for organized notes
